Flextable in a card with picture and Excel downloads

Source: R/chart-table_card.R
cd_table_card_ui.Rd

A card that shows a formatted table (a flextable) on screen, with two downloads in the card's header: the table as a picture and its data as an Excel workbook. Use it for a table whose layout matters, such as a scorecard. The Overall Score page uses it. For a plain table of data, use cd_table_ui().

Usage

cd_table_card_ui(id, i18n, title, ..., width = 12)

cd_table_card_server(
  id,
  i18n,
  data,
  table_fun,
  filename,
  sheet = "lbl_score_metric_header",
  about = NULL
)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

title

The card's title: text that is already translated (i18n$t("...")), or a tag.

...

More arguments for the kit's cd_chart_card(), which passes them to cd_card(): for example status = "success".

width

The card's width, passed to the kit's cd_chart_card(). Default 12. The kit's card takes a width and ignores it: a card is as wide as the place it is put in.

data

A reactive that returns what the table shows. It is given to table_fun and written to the Excel workbook.

table_fun

A function function(data) that returns the flextable.

filename

A reactive that returns the first part of the downloaded files' name. The date and time and the extension are added to it.

sheet

The translation key of the workbook's sheet name. Default "lbl_score_metric_header".

about

What the table is, for the app's AI: NULL (the default), a list, or a function that returns a list. See datasuite.ui::ai_register_component().

Value

cd_table_card_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags (the card).

cd_table_card_server() returns nothing useful. It is called for what it does.

Details

The page gives the data and one function that turns it into a flextable. The table on screen and the picture are drawn with the same function, so they always match. The picture is a PNG file. The workbook holds data() on one sheet. Both files are named filename() followed by the date and time.

The table is drawn once data() has a value. It is also registered with the app's AI bridge, which can then list it and read its data.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a page's ui
cd_table_card_ui(ns("score"), i18n, i18n$t("title_score_main"), status = "success")

# in the page's server
cd_table_card_server("score", i18n,
  data = reactive(my_scores(cache())),
  table_fun = function(d) flextable::flextable(d),
  filename = reactive("overall_score")
)
} # }
